about_the_game:
Buy this and you will add more Magic Stones of Sacred Light to your Game, with these you can revive with your fury bar activated in the same spot you were defeated.

All the buyed Magic Stones have to be installed to receive correctly all the Magic Stones you buyed until now, even used Magic Stones have to remain installed.

All the Magic Stones are cumulative, the quantity purchased will be added to your total of Magic Stones.

if you buy:

5=5

5+5 = 10

10+10+10=30

10+40= 50

100+20+5+20 = 145

Infinite = 999.900.000

1 Magic Stone is consumed when you revive.

content_descriptors.notes: Blood on Gameplay, violent cutscenes, obscene language, some crazy charachter.
